provenance.source: the forty mini-ISG frames, drafted under prompts.step1_prompt(O_ISG, P_ISG)
provenance.note_en: Claude Opus 5 was shown the frame and the step-1 prompt below, and its triplet lines are recorded here verbatim. The call was made from the Claude Code session that built this set and not through `app/vlm/claude.py`, so a graph replayed from it is `reconstructed`: the application did not call a model. The same model then produced the corrected reference annotations in data/slices/mini-isg/annotations.json, so the difference between a draft here and the reference there is not an independent measurement of what a human annotator finds that a model misses. It is what one model found on a second, slower look.
provenance.note_zh: 本檔各筆 completion 係將影格與下列 step-1 提示詞交付 Claude Opus 5 後，逐字記錄其輸出之三元組。該次呼叫由建置本資料集之 Claude Code 工作階段發出，並未經由 `app/vlm/claude.py`，故據以重播所建之場景圖一律標記為 reconstructed：應用程式本身並未呼叫模型。data/slices/mini-isg/annotations.json 之修正後標註亦由同一模型產生，故此處草稿與該處參考標註之差異，並非人工標註者較模型多發現若干關係之獨立量測，而係同一模型二次審視之結果。

exchanges.prompt:
INFORMATION
You are given one video frame from an industrial workcell.
Extract every relation you can see as <subject, predicate, object> triplets.

TRIPLETS EXTRACTION CRITERIA -- object categories
- hand
- beam
- brace
- block
- wheel
- axle
- pin
- nut
- washer
- assembly
- instruction sheet
- workbench

TRIPLETS EXTRACTION CRITERIA -- predicate dictionary
- holding
- assembling
- attached to
- inserted into
- on
- near
- reaching for

TRIPLETS EXTRACTION CRITERIA -- examples
[positive] <hand, assembling, assembly> -- The hand is working on the partly built model; `assembling` is in P.
[negative] <hand, tightening, nut> -- `tightening` is not in P, so this triplet cannot be scored at all.

OUTPUT
One triplet per line, in <subject, predicate, object> form.
exchanges.completion:
<hand, holding, assembly>
<hand, tightening, nut>
<assembly, on, workbench>
<brace, on, workbench>
